input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet on my phone is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed—nothing less will do. Can you help me fix this? I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next to get my internet speed fixed.
I tried running a speed test, but it failed due to no connection. What should I do next to get my mobile data working and achieve excellent internet speed?
My status bar shows that Airplane Mode is enabled. I don’t see any signal bars or network type, and I can’t tell if Mobile Data is enabled from what’s displayed. What should I do next?
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, my status bar shows a poor signal, 2G network, and it looks like mobile data is disabled. What should I do next to get excellent internet speed?
I’ve enabled Mobile Data, but my status bar still shows a poor signal and 2G network. What should I do next to switch to 4G or 5G and get excellent internet speed?

I’ve changed the network mode to 4G/5G Preferred. Now my status bar shows excellent signal strength and 5G network with mobile data enabled. Should I try another speed test to check if my internet speed is excellent now?

I ran another speed test, but it still failed due to no connection, even though my phone shows excellent signal strength and 5G. What should I do next? This is getting frustrating—I really need excellent internet speed.
I don’t want to change my plan, but I’m willing to add more data. Please add 2GB to my line so I can get my internet working again. Let me know when it’s done so I can check my speed.

I tried running another speed test, but it still failed due to no connection. My phone still shows excellent signal and 5G with mobile data enabled. What should I do next? I really need to get excellent internet speed.

I checked my APN settings, and the APN name is set to "internet" with the MMSC URL as "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." Nothing looks unusual to me. What should I do next to get my internet working at excellent speed?

I reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my phone, but the speed test still fails due to no connection. My phone still shows excellent signal and 5G with mobile data enabled. What else can I do? I really need excellent internet speed.
